log.note:
B1 done (CLAIMED). Changes: ProjectSidebar.tsx new prop openIds?: ReadonlySet<string>; data-open="" on .sidebar-group (Manuscript/Fragments/Research only) when it is the active destination or holds an open id (search/collapse do not change it), and on .entry-row (sections, fragments, collection rows incl. the source PDF row `pdf:<sourceId>`). Entry .selected is now also gated on the entry being in openIds (so .selected rows are a subset of [data-open] rows). App.tsx computes openIds after focusedPane: when `writing`, split drawn (split && splitLeft -- NOT splitPanes, which is null for a PDF pane) -> left id + right entry id or pdf:<sourceId>; else the active entry; destination pages (Settings/Comments/Bibliography/Read) -> empty. styles.css: doubling rule deleted and replaced by `.sidebar-group[data-open] > .group-heading .group-title {600; color: var(--tint, var(--accent))}` and `.sidebar .entry-row[data-open](, .entry-main) {600; --text}`; :active overrides rewritten for [data-open] (entry stays --text, header keeps its colour while pressed); Color rule no longer tints .entry-row.selected (only .group-title.selected); cards-view selected border/detail-weight rules extended to [data-open]. Entry icons keep the Color tint rule. Real font-weight for state; the shared hover stroke+1.04 scale still applies on top of a lit row (tested: hover and keyboard focus on the open row give matrix(1.04..) and stroke > 0, weight stays 600).
DEVIATIONS from plan text (please confirm with owner): (a) bottom groups (Read/Comments/History/Settings) get no data-open and keep TODAY's look -- in Plain that is 600 + --text (via .sidebar .group-title.selected), not '600 + accent' as the plan states; Color: accent. (b) On a destination page (Settings, Comments, Bibliography, Read mode) no entry and no section header is lit, because no entry is on screen; wave 3 kept the entry bold there. Owner will notice this in the hand check.
Contrast (stop-and-ask not triggered): Plain accent #0069d9 on --surface #f5f5f7 = 4.79, on --sidebar 4.54; dark #64a8ff on #28282c = 6.0, on #252529 = 6.24. No new token.
Pre-existing, unchanged: an open row's word count <small> inherits 600 (wave 3 did the same via .sidebar .selected).
Tests: sidebar-selection.spec.ts +5 (Plain rule incl. hover/keyboard/press/Enter/Settings; 4x palette x scheme split + fragment beside + right-pane focus + source PDF beside lights Research); split-view.spec.ts +1 (both panes lit, close restores); layout.spec.ts:27 and appearance.spec.ts (Color entry tint -> text + header tint; 'bold alone' test rewritten) updated to the new rule (registered on T181).
